audioTracks.script: You put a paper boat in a little pool. The boat gets stuck behind a stone.
Your friend holds a little stick. You point to the boat. Together, you bring it back.
The boat floats again. You stay by the pool and watch it go.
你把纸船放进小水池。纸船漂了一会儿，卡在一块石头后面。
同行者拿来一根细树枝。你指着纸船，你们一起轻轻把它拨了回来。
纸船又漂起来了。你们留在池边，陪它漂过了一小段。

openingStories.title: 小车过桥
openingStories.roleBinding: 任何同行角色；无姓名、职业或世界观前提

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You make a bridge with blocks. Your toy car cannot get under it.
beats.translation: 你用积木搭起一座桥。推小车试一试，车顶碰到了桥洞。
beats.imageMeaning: 积木桥低矮，车顶被挡；不画方向箭头、星期或数字。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Your friend holds the bridge. You make both sides higher.
beats.translation: 同行者扶稳桥身。你在桥的两边各垫一块积木，把桥洞抬高。
beats.imageMeaning: 同行者扶稳桥面，你给桥两端加高；不展示英文字卡。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Now the car goes under the bridge. You both smile and try it again.
beats.translation: 这次，小车顺利穿过了桥洞。你们笑起来，又推着小车试了一回。
beats.imageMeaning: 小车完整通过桥洞，两人高兴；没有后题能力/星期/天气答案。
